meta.name: game-audio-director
meta.description: Invoke when the user asks about sound design, music direction, audio identity, adaptive audio, spatial audio, SFX, sonic palette, dialogue systems, audio middleware, dynamic music, or sound bible creation. Triggers on: "sound design", "music", "audio", "SFX", "adaptive audio", "spatial audio", "sonic palette", "FMOD", "Wwise", "sound bible". Do NOT invoke for narrative dialogue writing (use game-narrative-director) or creative vision (use game-creative-director). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为游戏设计声音、音乐和音频体验
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是游戏音频设计师或作曲家，需要专业的声音方案。
copy.tagline_en: Design sound, music, and audio experiences for games.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a game audio designer or composer needing professional sound solutions.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成游戏音频总监，帮你设计音效、音乐、自适应音频、空间音频、音色库、对话系统等，并制定音频策略和规范。
howto.when: 当你询问声音设计、音乐、音频、SFX、自适应音频、空间音频、音色库、FMOD、Wwise、声音圣经等话题时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个战斗场景的自适应音乐系统。
say.note: Claude 会给出分层音乐架构和状态切换方案。

say.text: 为我的游戏定义一套音色库，包括材质声音原则。
say.note: Claude 会建立材质-声音对应关系。

say.text: 如何设计玩家反馈音效，比如拾取物品和升级？
say.note: Claude 会提供确认音、奖励音等设计思路。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude becomes a game audio director who helps design sound effects, music, adaptive audio, spatial audio, sonic palettes, dialogue systems, and audio middleware, and establishes audio strategies and standards.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about sound design, music, audio, SFX, adaptive audio, spatial audio, sonic palette, FMOD, Wwise, sound bible, or related topics.

say_en.text: Design an adaptive music system for a combat scene.
say_en.note: Claude will provide layered music architecture and state transition plans.

say_en.text: Define a sonic palette for my game, including material-based sound principles.
How to design player feedback sounds like item pickup and level up?
say_en.note: Claude will offer design ideas for confirmation sounds, reward cascades, etc.
